global_enabled.description: Enable the OVN Interconnection controller daemon on startup.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. Choose from: daemon, trace, debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

log_dir.description: Directory where OVN-IC logs and runtime files are stored.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the OVN-IC process.

sb_db_connection.description: Connection method and path to the OVN Southbound database (e.g., Unix socket or remote TCP).

sb_connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a connection to the Southbound DB before timing out.

sb_connection_retry_interval.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before retrying a failed Southbound DB connection.

nb_db_connection.description: Connection method and path to the OVN Northbound database (e.g., Unix socket or remote TCP).

nb_connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a connection to the Northbound DB before timing out.

nb_connection_retry_interval.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before retrying a failed Northbound DB connection.

ic_enabled.description: Enable OVN Interconnection mode (required for multi-region deployments).

region_id.description: Unique identifier for this OVN region (e.g., 'us-east-1', 'region-alpha').

chassis_id.description: Unique identifier for this chassis (node) within the region. Must be globally unique if multi-region.

external_ids.description: Key-value map of external IDs to attach to the chassis. Often used to bind chassis to physical hosts or cloud metadata.

interconnection_peers.description: List of OVN regions to interconnect with (multi-region support). Each entry defines a peer region connection.

name.description: Internal name for this peer configuration block (alphanumeric + hyphen).

region_name.description: Name of the peer region (must match its region_id in its ovn-ic.conf).

connection.description: Connection string to the peer region’s NB/SB DB (e.g., 'tcp:192.168.10.1:6641').

bidirectional.description: If true, synchronize changes in both directions. If false, sync only from this region to peer.
